snippet.title: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4262620/The_Alighieri_Circle_Dantes_Bloodline/

Hell is not a place of fire: it is a mirror of your soul.

Step into the shoes of Gabriele Alighieri in this first-person psychological thriller. Every 33 years, the barrier between our world and the Inferno fades. To save your family, you must return to your ancestral Italian villa and perform a ritual you have spent your life fleeing.

There is no combat here: only the suffocating tension of the unknown and a dark, modern reimagining of the Divine Comedy.

Entalto on X: https://x.com/EntaltoStudios
One-o-One on X: https://x.com/One_O_One_Games
